villagemaster/31961.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Do you know when the blacksmiths of Schuttgart Territory are the happiest? It's the moment we walk out of our shop and breathe in that cold fresh air after working long hours surrounded by scorching heat and banging noise. That moment feels like heaven! How many other occup…

links.text: Listen to information about 2nd class transfer.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/31961-.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Come in! So, you spoke to Yumi? I have absolutely no idea what Yumi wants you to do, but I'm sure you'll have no problem doing it. So, do you have business with me?
Head Blacksmith Newyear: Do you need something else? The letter only mentioned Starstones. Send Yumi my regards, will you?

Q00121_PavelTheGiant/31961-01.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Have you ever thought about working for us dwarves? Near this area lies the Pavel Ruins . I sent an investigator there a while ago, but got nowhere with their reportings. If you are experienced enough, I'd like to send you there.

Q00121_PavelTheGiant/31961-00.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: You have the right look, I won't argue that. Now let's find out if you have the skills. Show me how you hold a weapon... Hmm... I've been a blacksmith here for almost 100 years. I've seen every manner of warrior. Your hands are too far apart, your grip is loose, and your st…

Q00121_PavelTheGiant/31961-03.html.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: In the heart of the Ruins of Pavel there is a Dwarven barracks. There you will find my associate, Collector Yumi . She'll give you a job if you tell her I sent you.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-02b.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Oh, come now. You've already gotten a fine set of Clan Academy armor from Blacksmith Pinter of Gludio. (This quest is not available to characters who are engaged in the quest To Lead and Be Led.)

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-02a.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Oh, don't be greedy, now. You've already received a set of Clan Academy armor from Blacksmith Pinter of Gludio... (This quest is not available to characters who are engaged in the quest To Lead and Be Led.)

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-04..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: First, you must defeat the Brun Lizardmen to the south of the village , and then bring me 10 bottles of their blood . Their blood is the activator in the epoxy I use for the armor. Go, make haste!

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Great! Fine work! Now, I need some D-Grade Crystals... but before we get into that, I need to know what kind of armor you want. That will dictate the terms of our agreement, including, of course, the number of crystals you will need to gather.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-06a.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Go ask your sponsor to bring 922 D-Grade Crystals . Come, now, don't make a long face. These crystals are integral to the process of making the armor. I can't afford to supply them for free - this isn't a charity, you know. What's that you say? You don't have a sponsor? Oh,…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-06b.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Go ask your sponsor to bring 771 D-Grade Crystals . Come, now, don't make a long face. Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-15..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Well, these are all the materials I need for the armor, but... I have one last whim. I want to see just how close you and your sponsor really are. Go to the southwest of the village and defeat the Piccat Arachnids . Bring me 8 Arachnid legs as proof. But here's the catch: y…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-16..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Go to the southwest of the village and defeat the Piccat Arachnids . Bring me 8 Arachnid legs as proof. But here's the catch: you must defeat the Piccat Arachnid while your sponsor is watching. I think this is the perfect chance for you to show your sponsor how much you've …

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-17..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: And here you are, with your Arachnid trophy! I trust your sponsor was suitably impressed. He should be. Here's the armor. I hope it serves you well.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/31961-.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: You have a letter from Yumi, do you? Yes, of course, show it to me... hmmm. Well. You need Starstones? Heh, those are not cheap, but I'll do what I can to help. Here you go. Take them.

Q00121_PavelTheGiant/31961-02.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: You're full of confidence, I see. Well, that's right and proper; you have the skill to back it up. Just the sort of adventurer I need! In the heart of the Ruins of Pavel there is a Dwarven barracks. There you will find my associate, Collector Yumi . She will give you a job …

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-03..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Oh, don't you worry about getting this for free. Nothing's for nothing, you know. In fact, you will need to fetch me every single piece of material required to make it! But it'll be worth the effort, I promise you. You can't buy this kind of armor in a store. First, you mus…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05a.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Okay, heavy armor it is. But I'm going to give you one chance to reconsider, for once I start making this suit, there's no way to reverse the choice.

links.text: Tell him you want heavy armor.
Tell him you will think about it again.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05b.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Very well, one suit of light armor. But I'm going to give you one chance to reconsider, for once I start making this suit, there's no way to reverse the choice.

links.text: Tell him you want light armor.
Tell him you will think about it again.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05c.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: A robe it shall be, then. But I'm going to give you one chance to reconsider, for once I start making this item, there's no way to reverse the choice.

links.text: Tell him you want robe armor.
Tell him you will think about it again.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05d.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Very well, heavy armor then. But I don't think you have the number of D-Grade Crystals I'll need for this; you're far too inexperienced. Perhaps you could ask your sponsor to bring 922 D-Grade Crystals . Come now, don't make a long face. These crystals are integral to the p…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05e.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Light armor it is, then. But I don't think you have the number of D-Grade Crystals I'll need for this; you're far too inexperienced. Perhaps you could ask your sponsor to bring 771 D-Grade Crystals . Come now, don't make a long face. These crystals are integral to the proce…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05f.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: I will make you a robe, then. Unfortunately, I suspect that you won't have the number of D-Grade Crystals I'll need for this; you're far too inexperienced. Perhaps you could ask your sponsor to bring 771 D-Grade Crystals . Come, now, don't make a long face. These crystals a…

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-05g.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Very well. Think it over and let me know.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-08..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Ah, here you are again. Did you bring the D-Grade Crystals as we arranged?

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-09..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Who are you? A sponsor, you say, but whose? Go get your apprentice. I can't be expected to remember every apprentice and every sponsor, can I?

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-10..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Thank you for supplying these crystals. Now I have something to tell your apprentice, so please ask him to come talk to me.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-11..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: Well, what is this? I need more crystals. Please bring me 922 D-Grade Crystals if you want this job done.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-11a.text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: These aren't enough crystals. Please bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals so that I can make your armor.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-12..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: I have something to tell your apprentice, so please ask him to come talk to me.

Q00123_TheLeaderAndTheFollower/31961-14..text: Head Blacksmith Newyear: I don't think you have any business here — this is my place, and I have nothing to discuss with you.
